"Find your tribe! It is exhausting trying to explain what you need & how you feel to people that just dont get it. But there are campaigns that focus on Black mental health like @USER  and resources and advocates such as @USER and @USER #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"I encourage people to unapologetically prioritize their wellness. That means seeking support without shame, stepping away from toxic situations without guilt and building your own table without explanation when a seat at their table isnt intentionally provided. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL HTTPURL"

"Simple things like, "You should see a counselor". And hard things spoken in love like when a close friend said to me "I am not your therapist". I love her for setting that boundary (for her own mental health) while holding me accountable for my own wellness. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"
"Physically, my body can feel heavy too. And my sleeping patterns change. Either I am sleeping too much or not at all. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"For me, its extreme fatigue & an inability to focus. I will isolate, cancel plans or wont respond to messages of any kind (email, voicemail, etc). It can also be a very physical feeling; there a sensation when my mood shifts. It took years but I recognize it now. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"It also took some time for me to find the right counselor. If I couldnt talk about frustrations that stem from racism and sexism or if they didnt understand why activism and advocacy had to be a part of my mental health plan, they were not right counselor for me. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"Disbelief. On the outside looking in, I am successful & even privileged (in some aspects). So this idea that I was managing something that would make it hard for me to get out of bed....many people had a hard time believing it. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"Where do we begin? Access to culturally competent AND culturally responsive mental health care providers. Access to affordable services. A community understanding of the interconnectedness of social inequalities and the havoc they wreak on mental wellbeing. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"But even beyond the common myths, there exists in the Black community a justifiable distrust of most health institutions. That is just as strong of barrier to good mental health as myths and stigma. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"
"There are the common myths in the Black community like "Depression is for White folks" and "You are too blessed to be stressed and just need some Jesus!" #b4stage4chat HTTPURL HTTPURL"
"Exactly!  #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"

"I am extremely high-functioning. As a result, many people have a hard time acknowledging and/or understanding my depression. I used to let this bother me (which wasnt good for my mental health). Now I recognize it as a form of ignorance and work to educate others. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"
"I am a Black, cisgender, heterosexual woman who is a wife, mother, Christian, PhD educated university instructor and community advocate. I am also a first-generation American. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"
"My name is Nadia Richardson. I am the Founder of No More Martyrs, a mental health awareness campaign that seeks to build a community of support for Black women and girls. #b4stage4chat HTTPURL"
